title: fix(registry): advertise reasoning on Azure GPT nano/mini
author: iotserver24
pr_body_excerpt:
## Summary
- Set `reasoning: true` on `openai/gpt-5.4-nano`, `openai/gpt-5-nano`, and `openai/gpt-5.4-mini`
- They already accept `reasoning_effort`; this only updates `/models` capability metadata

Fixes #14028

## Test plan
- [x] `cd gen.pollinations.ai && npx vitest run test/models-retrieve.test.ts -t 'advertises reasoning'`
- [ ] Spot-check `/v1/models` capabilities include `reasoning` for the three IDs

gist.headline: The tiny thinkers speak up
gist.blurb: Three Azure GPT small-but-thoughtful models now correctly raise their little reasoning flags. The model registry has stopped being modest about what they can do.
gist.summary: Updated `/v1/models` capability metadata to advertise `reasoning: true` for `openai/gpt-5.4-nano`, `openai/gpt-5-nano`, and `openai/gpt-5.4-mini`, which already accept `reasoning_effort`.
gist.impact: Clients inspecting the model registry can now discover reasoning support for all three Azure GPT nano/mini models and expose the appropriate controls automatically.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy model registry garden where three tiny labeled GPT seedling pots each display a small glowing thought bubble, representing correctly advertised reasoning capability. Polli, wearing librarian glasses and holding a registry clipboard, carefully attaches the missing reasoning badges while code-vines grow around a retro terminal.
